entry.name: forward
entry.digest: Send messages to specified receive objects
entry.description: Relays messages to other objects remotely. Unlike the send object, the destination receive object of forward can be changed with each message.

arguments.name: receiver
arguments.description: Sets the name for theobject which will receive messages. This name can later be changed with themessage.
